criteria.statement: Audit one permissioned report, bibliography and source bundle; retain reviewer receipt.
A passing unit-test suite never upgrades a product to real_world_verified. Missing or unsupported evidence is inconclusive, never a pass.
immutable input fingerprints and source locators
product version, rule/profile version and configuration
declared acceptance criteria and applicability assumptions

criteria.measured_by: failure records repro_cmd; REPORT.md toolchain section

criteria.statement: raw test/check outputs, including failures and skipped checks
findings with evidence references and pass / fail / inconclusive
reviewer identity/role, decision, timestamp and rationale
labelled evaluation metrics where a holdout set exists
criteria.reason: no labelled holdout set exists for this pilot corpus; not measured, not claimed

criteria.statement: every finding must resolve to a source span or be explicitly marked as a heuristic prompt
criteria.measured_by: claim_evidence_audit:source_locator_integrity (slice == quote at declared offsets, sha256 matches)

criteria.reason: the audited corpus has no bibliography section, so no citation resolves and precision is undefined on this run; reported inconclusive by citation_audit

criteria.statement: support classification macro-F1 >= 0.80 on the labelled holdout
criteria.reason: no >=100-pair labelled holdout in this pilot; both auditors are structural and make no semantic-support judgement

criteria.statement: Human reviewers can reproduce each finding from the cited source.
criteria.measured_by: evidence locator (source + offsets + sha256) per finding; repro_cmd per record

criteria.statement: Any unresolvable extraction or unavailable source is `inconclusive`, never silently passed.

applicability_assumptions: the audited corpus is a permissioned internal report (permission_basis=internal_consent) with an in-tree verbatim copy used as the locator root
the two auditors are structural: they verify record linkage, source paths, offsets and hashes; they do not judge whether a source semantically supports a claim
the pilot exercises the six-check framework on one real corpus; it does not claim calibrated/operational readiness (G3/G4)

This version transcribes the matrix row/record bullets and the PRD acceptance bullets verbatim (D2) and is hashed with canonical_sha256 (D1); the superseded freeze is retained here instead of being overwritten (D8).
